shellCommands.command:
npx next dev -p 3001 &
DEV_PID=$!
sleep 3
curl -s http://localhost:3001/
curl -s http://localhost:3001/product
kill $DEV_PID

npx next start -p 3002 &
PROD_PID=$!
sleep 2
echo "--- Prefetch request without partialPrefetching ---"
curl -s -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3002/product
echo ""
echo "--- Segment prefetch request ---"
curl -s -H "rsc: 1" -H "next-router-segment-prefetch: /_full" http://localhost:3002/product
kill $PROD_PID

npx next start -p 3002 &
PROD_PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -i -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3002/product
kill $PROD_PID

npx next start -p 3002 &
PROD_PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -iL -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3002/product
kill $PROD_PID

npx next start -p 3002 &
PROD_PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -i -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3002/product?_rsc=HEAvJdHAQJrUAe2K"
kill $PROD_PID

npx next start -p 3002 &
PROD_PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -i -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full" "http://localhost:3002/product"
kill $PROD_PID

npx next start -p 3002 &
PROD_PID=$!
sleep 2
curl -i -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full" "http://localhost:3002/product?_rsc=xhdorIanPcIpYSsE"
kill $PROD_PID
